label: A contingent receiver admits opposite giving assignments under the same inertia law
paraphrase: On the necessary-origin control, fix both worlds, the recipient, an everywhere empty inducer predicate, standing receipt and the same origin-or-inertia explanation. At moment 2 of the actual history the earlier presence at 1 explains the recipient, with no origin-giving then and positive sustained giving then. The productive bridge and standing correlativity fail for origin-only giving and hold for sustained giving. The inherited necessary-origin bundle uses origin-only giving.
